newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore extends port limits by three-miles.
newsitem.headline: Singapore extends port limits by three-miles.

text.p: Singapore has extended its port limits on its southern and eastern seaboards, a port marine circular issued by the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA) showed, industry sources said on Tuesday.
MPA said in the circular, a copy of which was obtained by Reuters on Tuesday, that the new port limits came into operation July 11 and the shipping community was informed on July 25.
MPA declined to elaborate on the new boundaries.
A bunker trader said he estimated the widening of the port limit represented a three-mile southward extension of the port limits off the island's southeastern and eastern coast.
The port limit was extended by one mile south on the south western seaboard, the trader said.
